configs.title: BTCUSDT 4h
configs.note: The only crypto configuration worth publishing. Returns concentrate in 2025: 2024 was flat, 2026 is weak. Trades pullbacks and exits on the ATR trail, with 172 of 192 exits coming from the trail rather than a target.

validation.warning: This configuration has not yet been reconciled against TradingView's own Strategy Tester. Treat it as a starting point for your own testing rather than a verified backtest.

configs.title: NFLX 1h
configs.note: Best-sampled result to date and profitable in every year of the sample. Trades pullbacks inside a slow trend, exiting almost entirely on the ATR trail: 116 of 118 exits were the trail, not a target. Sends few flip alerts.
